recommendation: If the separately reviewed local mounted capture cannot be admitted, add one dedicated read-only Ubuntu24.04/Node22.13.1 PR browser job and a portable runner that invokes the existing qualifiers. Do not lengthen or repurpose the existing19-minute native demo_admission job.

Per-PR concurrency cancels older appearance workflows on a matching new push; adding tracked fallback scripts/workflow creates a new source candidate. No bypass or CI mutation performed.
Existing dedicated read-only exact-head workflow is the suitable action-pin/environment/artifact pattern. Its native matrix does not provide browser evidence.
Canonical capture accepts new report/preview paths; bindings at668-686 include exactHEAD/runtime/build inputs. Default historic baseline files32-35 remain required.

minimalRunner.source: exact github.event.pull_request.head.sha, persist-credentials:false, contents:read, pinned existing checkout/setup-node/upload-artifact actions; no secrets, deploy or PR writes
minimalRunner.captureAdmission: Require complete,headStable,sourceStable and exact source/runtime/build/capture identities. Source capture stays physically inside checkout. Refuse existing output; preserve original failed evidence.
minimalRunner.jobs: Reuse exact11 existing matrix jobs; then3 SurvivalFresh plus2 reviewedSolo clips in each engine; then actual generated-worker offline scenario. Reports are unique, immutable and carry source/capture/child hashes. Reviewed Solo compatibility remains explicitly scoped; no strict-only claim.
minimalRunner.ports: 127.0.0.1 only; retain18773/18774/8771 distinct existing providers and exact HTML fixture exceptions. Offline provider must retain original HTML/worker with no response rewriting.
minimalRunner.bounds: Fresh runner-owned TMP/profile; unchanged200MiB live source floor and derived complete offline reservation. Outer job timeout90minutes; independent finite setup/capture/group limits (existing30minute matrix,30minute additional,10minute offline). Retain bounded logs/artifacts even after failure; a time budget is a failure bound, not an ETA.
minimalRunner.cleanup: Reuse strict browser/provider close reports, add verified Linux-specific owner guard for child/descendant cleanup and deferred interruption handling. Do not claim the existing Mac ps observer is already Linux-qualified. Stop later jobs when cleanup is unverified.
minimalRunner.offlineAdaptation: The exact actual-worker scenario exists only in ignored local helpers. Promote/review a portable observer with original installation selection and current audit-derived cap; do not reuse old500MiB cap. Current selection526999829bytes, observercap603979776bytes, profile reservation2080374784bytes; recompute from the new Linux audit. Linux runner uses ordinary local tmp rather than SMB identities.
minimalRunner.artifacts: always upload compact audit/inventory/manifest, runtime/browser/tool identity, all immutable reports/log tails/failure screenshots and wrapper hashes. No need to upload bulk500MiB installed profile or entire capture; artifact upload must not make failed qualification pass.

limitations: No hosted workflow or runner has been authored, committed, launched or installed by this assessment.
A new tracked runner/workflow changes the exact candidate/build-input binding; fresh emitted capture and exact-head results are required. It cannot retroactively qualify9dcff.
Linux browser results supplement retained macOS/source-specific evidence. They do not complete physical controller, phone/tablet, audible or unfamiliar-human checks.
Provisioning/network/hosted queue timing is unknown. No reliable elapsed ETA can be asserted before a hosted runner begins.
The in-progress fresh local volume approach remains preferred because it can finish current9dcff qualification without changing source.
